resources.string: M9 Box\'s background activity is limited by battery optimization.

Your files, calendar and contacts in one place.

Features:
* Clean, modern interface matching your provider's theme
* Upload files to your M9 Box account
* Share them with others
* Keep your favorite files and folders synced
* Search across all folders
* Auto Upload for photos and videos taken by your device
* Stay up to date with notifications
* Multi-account support
* Secure access with fingerprint or PIN
